{{Top|leg}}
The '''Galactic Caucus''' was a meeting of supporters organized by the [[Alliance of Free Planets]]. The fledging Alliance invited representatives of free [[Planet/Legends|planets]] or governments to potentially join the Alliance. [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]] sent [[Gender/Legends|his]] own [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomats]] from worlds under [[Zsinj's Empire|his control]], who reported that their area of space was free from [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] rule, but whose inhabitants wanted to remain apart from the new galactic government.<ref name="CTD">''[[Cracken's Threat Dossier]]''</ref>
